title: Introducing Bujeti Perks: $2M+ in tools, credits and discounts for your business | Bujeti
summary: All-in-one financial management for African businesses. Track expenses, automate payments, issue corporate cards, and streamline your finances with Bujeti.
body_markdown:
Running a business means paying for a lot more than payroll, suppliers and software. Cloud infrastructure, AI tools, analytics, developer platforms, marketing services and business communications all draw from the same account, and the total climbs fast. Most of it leaves every month without anyone stopping to ask whether it had to.


Today we are launching Bujeti Perks: a growing collection of software credits, discounts and partner deals available exclusively to Bujeti customers. Together, they are worth more than $2M, and they cover the tools businesses actually run on.


##### Financial control is also about spending less


Bujeti is built to give businesses better control and visibility over their finances. But financial control is not only about knowing where your money goes. It is also about finding ways to make that money go further.


Bujeti Perks extends that value beyond financial management. The same account you use to track spend, set budgets and approve payments now gives you access to deals across the wider stack you use to operate. Whether you are building your product, running your infrastructure, growing your team or acquiring customers, there are perks designed to take real cost off the table.


Here is what is inside.


######


###### Cloud and infrastructure


The largest credits in the network sit here, where hosting and bandwidth costs scale fastest as you grow.


-


Google Cloud: up to $350K in credits


-


Cloudflare: up to $350K in credits


-


Microsoft Azure: up to $150K in credits


-


AWS: up to $100K in credits


-


OVHcloud and Deutsche Telekom (T Cloud): up to €100K each


-


Vercel: up to $30K in credits, plus startup cloud support from DigitalOcean


For a business already spending on cloud, these offers can cover a meaningful share of the year's infrastructure bill.


##### AI and machine learning


AI has moved from experiment to line item. These perks help you build with it without the cost climbing out of view.


-


Anthropic: startup API credits and support for teams building with Claude


-


Deepgram: up to $100K in voice AI credits


-


LangChain: up to $10K in LangSmith credits


-


Startup credits and benefits from Fireworks AI and ElevenLabs


#####


##### Data and databases


The layer underneath every product, from your first table to production scale.


-


Neon: up to $200K in credits for Postgres infrastructure


-


Aiven: up to $100K in credits


-


Atlas credits and startup support from MongoDB


-


Data and AI resources from Databricks, streaming credits from Confluent, and free credits from Airtable


#####


##### Developer tools


Everything your engineering team ships with, from source control to CI and authentication.


-


Replit: up to $25K in credits


-


CircleCI: up to $20K in CI/CD credits


-


GitHub: $10K in platform credits, and Algolia: $10K in search credits


-


GitLab Ultimate free for a year, Linear Business free for eligible teams, plus Temporal, Clerk and Auth0


#####


##### Analytics and monitoring


You cannot fix what you cannot see. These keep your systems and your product data in view.


-


Datadog: up to $100K in credits


-


Grafana Cloud: up to $100K in credits


-


Amplitude and Mixpanel: one year free


-


Startup app monitoring benefits from Sentry


#####


##### Sales, marketing and support


The tools your commercial teams live in, at a fraction of list price.


-


HubSpot: up to 90% off


-


Intercom: 93% off in year one


-


Zendesk: free for up to two years


-


Startup benefits from Brevo for email and marketing automation


#####


##### Productivity, HR, finance and legal


The back office that keeps the company running.


-


Notion: up to six months of Business free


-


Atlassian: Jira and Confluence free for 12 months


-


Deel: eligible founder payroll free in the US


-


Docusign for e-signatures, Miro and Asana for collaboration, and Framer Pro free for a year


######


###### Supporting businesses closer to home


Bujeti Perks is not only about global technology names. We are working with businesses and service providers across Africa to give customers offers that matter to their day to day operations.


-


20% off PressOne Africa for business communications


-


15% off Ijeworks Media for photography and media services


-


25% off Max-Migold for professional and facility services


-


10% off Taxculate for US incorporation and tax


-


Two free consultation sessions and a functional prototype build with Cadreen


Our network is growing fast, and we are adding new partners regularly. If you run a product or service other businesses rely on, list it as a perk and put your offer in front of the 2,000+ businesses running on Bujeti.


#####
Built for businesses, not just startups


The cost of running a business does not stop once you have launched. More employees mean more software seats. More customers mean more infrastructure. More growth means more services and suppliers.


Bujeti Perks is designed to help businesses at different stages find savings across that stack. You might be claiming cloud credits while building your product, taking a discount on a business service you use every week, or getting a better rate on a tool your team already depends on. The goal is simple: help Bujeti customers keep more of their money while getting access to more of what they need to grow.


#####


##### Your Bujeti account should do more


A business finance platform should give you more than a view of your numbers. It should help you make better decisions, control spending and run a better business. Bujeti Perks is another step in that direction, and it is only the beginning. We are continuing to add partners and offers to the network.


Ready to unlock your perks? Bujeti Perks is available exclusively to Bujeti customers, inside your account.


[See the full list of perks](https://www.bujeti.com/perks)


Not a Bujeti customer yet?[Join Bujeti](https://www.bujeti.com/switch-to-bujeti) and unlock the perks available to your business. Controlling your money is step one. Making it go further is the next. Now both live in the same place.
